explanation: I found no Mathlib declaration that counts the stabilizer of a finset, viewed as a set, in Perm α. I grepped Mathlib for stabilizer_card, card_stabilizer, and stabilizer lemmas about Perm, Set and Finset. I also checked Perm/MaximalSubgroups.lean and SubMulAction/Combination.lean. Those files only contain coatom, preprimitivity and surjectivity results. They have no cardinality of the set stabilizer. The closest declaration is DomMulAct.stabilizer_card in Mathlib/GroupTheory/Perm/DomMulAct.lean. It gives Fintype.card {g : Perm α // f ∘ g = f} = ∏ i, (Fintype.card {a // f a = i})!. The theorem needs this only after specialising f to fun a => decide (a ∈ s). It also needs two further steps: an equivalence between the set stabilizer and {g // f ∘ g = f}, and the local lemma mem_stabilizer_coe_finset_iff. Because of those steps, the derivation is longer than one or two lines, so this is not a special case.
